items.title: AI hiring boom could turn into a surprise tailwind for software: Bernstein
items.summary: Investing.com -- Artificial intelligence could prove a surprise tailwind for software companies if productivity gains spur businesses to hire more workers rather than cut headcount, Bernstein analysts said, challenging one of the sector’s key bearish narratives.

items.title: ChronoScale Says It Plans a 50 MW Microsoft AI Deployment. Can CHRN Fund the Build Without Diluting Shareholders?
items.summary: ChronoScale said on August 27 that it plans with Microsoft to deploy 50 megawatts of AI infrastructure in North America using NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems and liquid cooling. The release did not disclose project pricing or committed revenue, although ChronoScale had already disclosed a two-year GPU services agreement with Microsoft tied to the planned deployment. […]

items.title: What Will Microsoft (MSFT) Reveal With Its New AI And Cloud Reporting?
items.summary: Microsoft (NasdaqGS:MSFT) announced plans to restructure its financial reporting and segment disclosures from fiscal 2027 to highlight AI and cloud activities.
